processing_design_facts.purpose: adult and employer needs research for AI4WORK STEP; aggregate needs analysis only
processing_design_facts.method_scope: bounded one-off needs-research campaign across Sud-Vest Oltenia, Sud-Muntenia and Centru; method-readiness thresholds are 120 adult and 45 employer responses, not representativeness claims and not evidence of need

evaluation_or_scoring.reason: only aggregate research synthesis; no person-level evaluation or scoring

automated_decision_with_legal_or_similar.reason: no decisions concerning an individual are permitted

systematic_monitoring.reason: no monitoring of behaviour or publicly accessible areas

sensitive_or_highly_personal_data.reason: special-category, criminal-conviction, direct-identifier and analytical free-text fields are forbidden

large_scale_processing.reason: the current design is a bounded one-off research campaign with narrow preset fields and method thresholds of 120 adult plus 45 employer responses across three regions; it is not a continuous population-scale database. Re-screen if response volume, duration, data breadth or geographic scope materially increases.

matching_or_combining_datasets.reason: CRM/contact linkage and cross-dataset identity matching are forbidden

vulnerable_data_subjects.reason: employee respondents may face a power imbalance, but participation is voluntary, refusal has no consequence, individual results cannot be disclosed to employers and the design performs no automated monitoring or recording of employees

innovative_technology_or_organisational_.reason: AI is the subject matter of the questionnaire; respondent-level processing itself is a conventional first-party form/store/export workflow with no AI/ML scoring, biometric, IoT, fingerprinting or rights-limiting technology

prevents_right_or_service_or_contract.reason: participation is optional and must not condition employment, a service or a contract

anspdcp_decision_174_2018_check.note: Decision 174/2018 is treated as a non-exhaustive mandatory-DPIA list. The current design does not match any listed trigger; re-screening remains mandatory on material change.

technical_assessment.reason: No high-risk combination is present: no person-level evaluation or consequential decision, no systematic monitoring, no special-category/criminal data, no dataset matching, no rights-limiting innovative processing, no biometric/IoT/location processing, no employer access to individual responses and no population-scale continuous database.
technical_assessment.article_36_prior_consultation: NOT_INDICATED_ON_CURRENT_SCREENING; reassess if a completed DPIA later identifies residual high risk

mandatory_before_prod.final_large_scale_assessment: NOT_LARGE_SCALE_ON_CURRENT_DOCUMENTED_METHOD_SCOPE; re-screen on material increase in volume, duration, data breadth or geography

fail_closed_rule: Controller identity is now determined, but this technical screening recommendation does not itself authorize PROD collection. EUROCONSULT SRL must accept the screening and safeguards before the activation gate may use DPIA_NOT_REQUIRED_APPROVED. If the controller concludes a DPIA is required, collection remains disabled until that DPIA is completed and approved and any Article 36 prior-consultation requirement is resolved.
re_screen_triggers: collection volume, duration or geographic scope materially increases
special-category, criminal-conviction, direct-identifier or analytical free-text data are proposed
respondent-level profiling, AI/ML scoring or automated decisions are introduced
employer access to person-level responses is proposed
monitoring, location, device, biometric, sensor or fingerprint data are introduced
purpose, lawful basis, retention, processor chain or security model materially changes
